title: SUNDAY MOBILITY
subtitle: SUNDAY. MOBILITY. OPEN THE DESK BACK, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN QUIET STRENGTH. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. SUNDAY. SUNDAY MOBILITY. FIFTEEN MINUTES. OPEN THE BACK, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN QUIET STRENGTH. DO NOT HIDE BEHIND THAT KEYBOARD, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. SUNDAY MOBILITY DONE. BACK OPEN. BALANCE HONEST. NOW GO ENJOY THE REST OF YOUR DAY WITHOUT MOVING LIKE A RUSTY HINGE.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: SCAPULAR ROW
exercises.cue: STAND TALL OR HINGE LIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN SLOW. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH AND POSTURE OPENER. NO YANKING.
exercises.speakStart: SCAPULAR ROWS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. OPEN THE BACK AFTER THAT DESK. DO NOT YANK LIKE YOU ARE STARTING A LAWNMOWER.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE SHOULDERS LOOSE.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. CHEST UP. LIGHT HAND ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT. OWN THE BALANCE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. STEP BACK. CHEST UP. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT WOBBLE ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY WEATHERVANE.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGE
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. FEET FLAT. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEELS. SQUEEZE AT THE TOP. SLOW LOWER. HIPS OPEN. CONTROL BEATS BOUNCING.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGES. TWO SETS OF TEN. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEELS. SQUEEZE AT THE TOP. SLOW LOWER. THIS IS YOUR HIP STRENGTH UNDER THE MOBILITY. DO NOT THRUST LIKE YOU ARE AUDITIONING FOR A BLOODY MUSIC VIDEO.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE HIPS LOOSE.

exercises.name: BODYWEIGHT SQUAT
exercises.cue: FEET ABOUT HIP WIDTH. SIT BACK SLOW. CHEST UP. THREE COUNT DOWN, STEADY UP. MOBILITY TEMPO. QUALITY BEATS RUSHING.
exercises.speakStart: BODYWEIGHT SQUATS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. SIT BACK SLOW. CHEST UP. THREE COUNT DOWN. THIS IS YOUR LEG STRENGTH UNDER THE MOBILITY. DO NOT BOUNCE LIKE A BLOODY PING PONG BALL.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK
exercises.cue: ON YOUR SIDE. ELBOW UNDER SHOULDER. HIPS UP FOR ABOUT FIVE SECONDS. KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. SWITCH SIDES. SHORT HOLDS. BUILD HONEST.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANKS. TWO ROUNDS. FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. ELBOW SET. HIPS UP. KNEE DOWN IS FINE. THIS IS YOUR CORE WORK. SHORT AND HONEST. DO NOT QUIT AT TWO SECONDS AND CALL IT A DAY.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. LOW BACK PRESSED DOWN. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG REACH SLOW. BREATHE. CONTROL BEATS SPEED.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUGS. TWO SETS. SIX EACH SIDE. LOW BACK DOWN. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. SLOW. THIS IS YOUR CORE FINISH UNDER THE MOBILITY. DO NOT FLOP LIKE A PANICKED BEETLE.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE CORE QUIET. I'M WATCHING.
exercises.speakDone: DEAD BUGS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
